versions.alt: New Year's Day morning in a busy city park with three big trees and many flowers: an old man reads a book at one end of a park bench, a mother sits resting at the other end, and her small son stands under a tree beside her; many people walk on the path behind

prompt.traditional: 公園裡有三＿＿大樹，環境很好。
prompt.simplified: 公园里有三＿＿大树，环境很好。

answer.traditional: 公園裡有三棵大樹，環境很好。
answer.simplified: 公园里有三棵大树，环境很好。
answer.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu sān kē dà shù, huánjìng hěn hǎo.
answer.english: There are three big trees in the park; it's a lovely place.

questions.why: Trees take the measure word 棵: 三棵大樹. 條 is for roads and 張 for tables.

prompt.traditional: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看書，已經看了一個小時＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看书，已经看了一个小时＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看書，已經看了一個小時了。
answer.simplified: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看书，已经看了一个小时了。
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zuò zài yǐzi shàng kàn shū, yǐjīng kàn le yí ge xiǎoshí le.
answer.english: The old man is reading on the bench; he has been reading for an hour now.

questions.why: 已經……看了一個小時了: the second 了 says he is still reading now. 過 and 的 can't end this sentence.

prompt.traditional: 今天是新年，＿＿公園裡的人比平常多。
prompt.simplified: 今天是新年，＿＿公园里的人比平常多。

answer.traditional: 今天是新年，所以公園裡的人比平常多。
answer.simplified: 今天是新年，所以公园里的人比平常多。
answer.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīnnián, suǒyǐ gōngyuán lǐ de rén bǐ píngcháng duō.
answer.english: Today is New Year's Day, so there are more people in the park than usual.

questions.why: 所以 brings in the result: it is New Year's Day, so the park is busier. 因為 would have to come before the reason, and 如果 (if) would leave the sentence unfinished.

versions.alt: New Year's Day morning in a busy city park with three big trees and many flowers: an old man reads a book at one end of a park bench, a mother sits resting at the other end, and her small son stands under a tree beside her; many people walk on the path behind

prompt.traditional: 那個孩子站在樹下面，他媽媽＿＿在椅子上休息。
prompt.simplified: 那个孩子站在树下面，他妈妈＿＿在椅子上休息。

answer.traditional: 那個孩子站在樹下面，他媽媽坐在椅子上休息。
answer.simplified: 那个孩子站在树下面，他妈妈坐在椅子上休息。
answer.pinyin: Nàge háizi zhàn zài shù xiàmiàn, tā māma zuò zài yǐzi shàng xiūxí.
answer.english: The child is standing under the tree, and his mom is sitting on the bench, resting.

questions.why: You rest sitting on a bench: 坐在椅子上. 住 means to live somewhere, and the child is the one standing (站).

prompt.traditional: 你們在公園裡玩了＿＿了？——一個多小時了，孩子還不想回家。
prompt.simplified: 你们在公园里玩了＿＿了？——一个多小时了，孩子还不想回家。

answer.traditional: 你們在公園裡玩了多久了？——一個多小時了，孩子還不想回家。
answer.simplified: 你们在公园里玩了多久了？——一个多小时了，孩子还不想回家。
answer.pinyin: Nǐmen zài gōngyuán lǐ wán le duōjiǔ le? Yí ge duō xiǎoshí le, háizi hái bù xiǎng huí jiā.
answer.english: How long have you been at the park? Over an hour now, and my child still doesn't want to go home.

questions.why: The reply gives a length of time (一個多小時了), so the question is 多久, how long. 多少 asks how many or how much, and 什麼 asks what.

prompt.traditional: 這個公園又大＿＿漂亮，花也很多。
prompt.simplified: 这个公园又大＿＿漂亮，花也很多。

answer.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán yòu dà yòu piàoliàng, huā yě hěn duō.
answer.english: This park is big and pretty, and it has lots of flowers too.

questions.why: 又……又…… joins two descriptions: 又大又漂亮, both big and pretty.

passage.traditional: 我在台北學中文學了半年{1}。十二月三十一號晚上，我跟同學去看跨年演唱會。那裡的人{2}我想的多，真熱鬧！因為人太多了，我們沒有地方坐，在那裡{3}了四個小時。我們回到家的時候，{4}兩點了。
passage.simplified: 我在台北学中文学了半年{1}。十二月三十一号晚上，我跟同学去看跨年演唱会。那里的人{2}我想的多，真热闹！因为人太多了，我们没有地方坐，在那里{3}了四个小时。我们回到家的时候，{4}两点了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiběi xué Zhōngwén xué le bàn nián le. Shí'èr yuè sānshíyī hào wǎnshàng, wǒ gēn tóngxué qù kàn kuànián yǎnchànghuì. Nàlǐ de rén bǐ wǒ xiǎng de duō, zhēn rènao! Yīnwèi rén tài duō le, wǒmen méiyǒu dìfāng zuò, zài nàlǐ zhàn le sì ge xiǎoshí. Wǒmen huí dào jiā de shíhòu, yǐjīng liǎng diǎn le.
passage.english: I've been studying Chinese in Taipei for half a year. On the night of December 31, my classmates and I went to a New Year's Eve concert. There were more people than I expected; it was so lively! It was too crowded to find a seat, so we stood there for four hours. When we got home, it was already two o'clock.

questions.why: 學了半年了: the second 了 says it has been half a year up to now, and the studying goes on.
比 compares the two: 那裡的人比我想的多, more people than I expected.
沒有地方坐 means there were no seats, so they 站了四個小時, stood for four hours. 坐 would contradict it.
回到家的時候，已經兩點了: it was already two o'clock when they got home.

passage.traditional: 上個月我去美國找姐姐，在她家住{1}兩個星期。她住的城市不大，可是{2}很好，她家前面有一個公園。我在那裡{3}，每天早上都跟姐姐去公園跑步。那裡的人走路走得比台北人{4}，大家都不太忙。
passage.simplified: 上个月我去美国找姐姐，在她家住{1}两个星期。她住的城市不大，可是{2}很好，她家前面有一个公园。我在那里{3}，每天早上都跟姐姐去公园跑步。那里的人走路走得比台北人{4}，大家都不太忙。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Měiguó zhǎo jiějie, zài tā jiā zhù le liǎng ge xīngqí. Tā zhù de chéngshì bú dà, kěshì huánjìng hěn hǎo, tā jiā qiánmiàn yǒu yí ge gōngyuán. Wǒ zài nàlǐ de shíhòu, měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu gēn jiějie qù gōngyuán pǎobù. Nàlǐ de rén zǒulù zǒu de bǐ Táiběi rén màn, dàjiā dōu bú tài máng.
passage.english: Last month I went to the US to visit my older sister and stayed at her place for two weeks. The city she lives in isn't big, but it's a lovely place, and there is a park in front of her home. While I was there, I went running in the park with her every morning. People there walk more slowly than people in Taipei, and nobody is very busy.

questions.why: 住了兩個星期: a stay of two weeks that is now over (the writer is back).
環境很好: the surroundings are nice, with a park in front of the home.
我在那裡的時候 means while I was there; it sets the time for 每天早上.
比台北人慢: they walk more slowly than people in Taipei, and 大家都不太忙 backs it up.
